register.labelZh: OPT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: opt for 可以幫助你說明自己在多個課程、產品、服務或計劃之中選擇了哪一個。；opt in 和 opt into 可以表示某人主動選擇加入服務、名單、活動計劃或其他安排。；opt out 和 opt out of 可以清楚表示某人選擇不參加,或決定退出原有安排。；OPT 片語動詞經常出現在網站、申請表、電郵設定、學校計劃和工作安排之中。
register.summaryEn: Opt for helps you explain which course, product, service or plan you choose from several possibilities. Opt in and opt into show that someone has actively chosen to join a service, list, programme or plan. Opt out and opt out of make it clear that someone has chosen not to participate or has decided to leave. OPT expressions often appear on websites, application forms, email settings, school programmes and workplace plans.
contextsZh: 理解表格、設定和會員選項
contextsEn: Show that joining is a free choice
Explain that someone does not want to take part
Understand forms, settings and membership choices

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Use opt for before the thing you choose: opt for the blue jacket Opt in means choosing to join or be included. Opt out means choosing not to take part or choosing to leave.
